title: Dashboard Tour
description: A walkthrough of the dashboard and its main sections.

segments.narrator: This is the dashboard. The main navigation sits on the left, and everything you need day to day is one click away.
The quick action tiles jump straight to the most common tasks. Hovering one previews where it goes before you commit to the click.
Opening Reports shows the same layout principle at a deeper level. Filters sit above the table, and the table scrolls independently.
